target.title: fix: restore shared mac release helper lookup
target.body:
## Summary

- point BlackBar's release wrapper at the current `release-mac-app` shared skill
- update the README to match the actual helper location

## Why

The shared skill was renamed from `mac-app-release` to `release-mac-app`, but BlackBar still searched only the old path. Every release helper command therefore failed with `Missing mac-release helper` even though the supported helper was installed next to the repository.

## Proof

- `bash -n Scripts/mac-release`
- `Scripts/mac-release status`
- `Scripts/generate-release-notes.sh 0.2.5 /tmp/blackbar-0.2.5-notes.md`
- `Scripts/check-release-assets.sh v0.2.4`
- `Scripts/verify_appcast.sh 0.2.4`
- `make ci` (25 tests, release build, universal app bundle)
- launched the exact locally built BlackBar 0.2.5 (build 10) bundle and verified the live Blacksmith status/dashboard menu rendered
- autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings

## Risk

Low. Two path/name replacements; the explicit `MAC_RELEASE_TOOL` override remains unchanged.
